text:
Alex K: Heads-up — Arclight (SaaS payments) wants a pre-sales POC to validate two things: 1) token billing parity vs their current vendor, 2) output consistency for our prompt shim. Goal: confirm no surprising cost deltas or major response drift.

Sahil (SE): Thanks. Do they have a specific prompt suite?

Alex K: Yes — 120 prompts (mix of short chat + long multi-turn). They care about session affinity for stateful chains and deterministic rerank outputs.

Jenna - Solutions: We should map their existing API fields to ours. Example mapping they use: `conversationId` -> our `session_id`, `prompt_text` -> `input`.

Arjun (Eng): For session handshake, we support sticky sessions and token-scoped KV. If they need identical latencies we can pin model variant.

Priya (Security): They'll also send a security questionnaire (SOC2 + data residency). Need to confirm log retention and KMS options.

Sahil (SE): On billing: they bill per 1K tokens with rounding rules. We need to show an apples-to-apples calc. Can we export a sample tokenized trace?

Arjun (Eng): Yes — we can run the prompt set through the exact model variant and produce token-level breakdowns. Quick curl we can give them:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-std","session_id":"<conversationId>","input":"<prompt_text>","stream":false}'
```

Alex K: Perfect. Also asked about response deltas: they observed truncated replies from the competitor on long context. We should highlight our KV prefix caching and longer context support.

Jenna - Solutions: Proposed POC steps:
1) Map 20 high-risk prompts and run side-by-side for 48 hours.
2) Collect token traces + cost estimate.
3) Share security questionnaire answers.
4) Joint readout with Arclight SRE.

Sahil (SE): I'll own step 1 & 2. Arjun, can you set up a small Dedicated pool for the 48hr run (no autoscale) and give us the endpoint?

Arjun (Eng): I can provision a pinned pool (g5x) and ensure model pinning. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Priya (Security): I'll prefill the SOC2 and KMS Qs and send to legal for review. Any special compliance flags from their procurement?

Alex K: They require EU-resident processing for EU customers. We should note region pinning.

Jenna - Solutions: I'll draft an intake doc and share the prompt mapping spreadsheet.

deploy-bot: Deployment created — redwood-testing/poc-arclight-2919 (owner: Arjun) :white_check_mark:

Alex K: Great. Action items: Sahil run side-by-side and gather traces, Arjun provision pool, Priya start security draft, Jenna produce mapping. Check-in Friday EOD? :thumbsup:

Sahil (SE): Friday EOD works. I'll post a short summary in this thread with initial numbers.

Arjun (Eng): Noted. Will post endpoint + credentials (ephemeral) here when ready.

Jenna - Solutions: Uploaded draft mapping to the shared drive: https://drive.company/arclight-poc-mapping (please comment).

Priya (Security): Adding a note — redact any PII from traces before sharing externally.

Alex K: Thanks team — let's keep this lean. If Arclight asks about model fallback behavior, call out our automatic fallback to quantized variants with identical API shape.

Sahil (SE): Copy that. Will include fallback cost delta in the report.
